description: Turn a photograph of a physical object into a dimensioned, standards-compliant 2D technical drawing (orthographic views, dimension lines, projection symbol). Supply the photo as a local file path, an http(s) URL or a data URL. Either let the model estimate real-world dimensions, or pass measurements you actually took so the drawing is anchored to real sizes. Choose the drafting standard (ISO/ANSI), sheet size, projection angle, drawing type and which views to include. Costs 5 credits. The drawing image is saved to disk and its path returned — feed that path to `image_to_dxf` for CAD geometry, or to `render_product` for a photoreal render.

drawing_type.description: working = fully dimensioned production drawing (default); assembly = numbered balloons + parts list; as-fitted = record of the item as built; patent = numbered figure, no dimensions.

estimate_dimensions.description: Let the model infer realistic real-world dimensions. Defaults to true when no measurements are given, false when they are.

image.description: The product photo: a local file path, an http(s) URL, or a data:image/…;base64,… URL.

measurements.description: Dimensions actually measured on the object. Every other feature is scaled proportionally from these, so one accurate measurement makes the whole drawing accurate.

position.description: Where on the object it was taken, e.g. "overall width", "seat height".

value.description: The measured length as a number, e.g. "120" or "4.5".

notes.description: Anything else to state on the drawing (material, finish, tolerances).

output_path.description: Where to save the drawing. Defaults to ./techdrawai-output/drawing-<timestamp>.png.

paper_size.description: Sheet size: A4/A3/A2/A1/A0 for ISO (default A3), or "ANSI A"…"ANSI E" for ANSI (default "ANSI B").

product_name.description: What the object is, e.g. "oak dining chair". Improves the title block and the estimated dimensions. Use `identify_product` first if you do not know.

projection.description: Projection angle. first-angle (default, ISO/Europe) or third-angle (ANSI/North America).

units.description: Primary drawing unit. Defaults to mm.

views.description: Which views to include. Defaults to front, top and side.

name: generate_technical_drawing
title: Generate a 2D technical drawing
